    "C02 passes for the frozen implementation and evidence. RF01–RF05 and their required evidence gaps are resolved. The crash model separately tracks visible and confirmed-durable documents, including cleanup ownership after an unconfirmed credential commit.",
    "Independently recomputed all four fingerprints and verified the source inventory, packet references, tool executable hashes, run-log hashes and fixture executable/bundle hashes. All matched. Rechecked the passing C01 receipt, verdict, raw-output hashes, completion record and base-commit ancestry.",
    "Retained passing results comprise 48 frontend, 23 core, 44 context/transport, 12 IPC, 6 Keychain and 164 published-SDK tests; the 30 targeted frontend tests overlap the 48. Independently reran the four existing in-memory fixture tests covering unconfirmed first entry, replacement, confirming retry and crash recovery after a landed write; all passed. No rebuild or full-suite rerun was performed.",
    "Directory-sync failure and crash recovery were tested through fault injection and a durable-state model, not real filesystem failure or power loss. Native acceptance is implementer-recorded fixture evidence with 12 passing checks; the reviewer did not relaunch the application or access credential stores or product endpoints. Only designated review artifacts were written.",
    "Native credentials use a dedicated fixture Keychain with app-controlled locking. Production signed identity/upgrade qualification remains C26. System proxy changes were exercised through environment variables, not changed macOS proxy settings; spoken VoiceOver and filesystem tracing were not recorded. Production Scan integration is C03, transport-policy UI is C15 and live qualification is C25; this verdict does not attest those later gates."
